column1: # Named differences of the image's product `check` (nbb.check-cli's Kotoba run) against `bin/amu check` (agent claude,
# 2026-10-10). judge.py reads this file; a difference not matched by a row is DIFF. Columns (tab separated):
#   id  kind  scope  key  host-value  image-value  reason
# kind NORM: same verdict, exit and phase; the text or a marker differs (prove-100 G2/G3 accept it).
# kind GAP: the image's behaviour differs (G3 lists it; CHECK_FULL FAILs while any GAP row is hit).
# scope: a corpus program (path relative to the repo, absolute outside it), `fx:<case line>` (args.sh), or `*`.
# Values are EDN, compared as data; `absent` = the key is missing. `*` (host side only) is allowed for the three
# whole-corpus rules below, each with the extra condition coded in judge.py.
